scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:server & npm run setup:client & npm run setup:mission:server & npm run setup:mission:client && wait
scripts.local:admin: concurrently --names "server,client,mission-control" -c "green.bold,cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run mission-control"
scripts.docker:dev: npm run develop && npm run develop:logs
scripts.docker:postgres: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose/develop.yml up postgres -d
scripts.docker:postgres:logs: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose/develop.yml logs postgres --follow --tail 10
scripts.docker:reload: docker compose -f compose.yml -f compose/develop.yml restart -d && npm run develop:logs
